name: stitch-ui
description: The Stitch UI: the harness in Alexandria dress

spec.why: The harness works; its room shows the machine's plumbing. The owner chose the direction (library-inspector, Alexandria editorial): one design system over both surfaces, the phase inspector as the library's third pane, and the seam contracts frozen.

requirements.text: A token layer (CSS custom properties) SHALL encode the Alexandria light system as default and the dark review variant as an alternate, with system font stacks (serif headline voice, sans body, mono status) — no webfonts, no CDN.
The theme toggle SHALL persist per surface (localStorage) and apply without flash on load; light is default.
The library SHALL adopt the no-line rule: structure via surface shifts; ghost borders (15% outline) only where structure demands.
The library SHALL render a third pane — the phase inspector — with the five phases, their states derived from pack state, and per-phase view focusing; the inspector SHALL NOT admit actions in v1.
The inspector SHALL render review telemetry: verdicts, findings counted by severity, reviewer claims; refreshed on interaction (poll), with the refresh posture stated in the UI.
The conformance phase SHALL render the alignment report (violations, gaps, the house sentence) as a panel.
The room SHALL be reskinned in the same system with the wizard contract frozen: question-by-question, Enter submits, honest unknown, approve at end, block-until-approved with Ctrl-C escape.
All existing seam, portability, and security contracts SHALL hold unchanged: events-only admission, engine-name-free assets, keyboard and pointer complete, CSP headers, route parity.
The journey strip in the dossier overview SHALL remain (factory pipeline is aspiration, recorded).

clarifications.question: The phase inspector v1: read-only as designed, or clickable phases that also act (answer/approve from the inspector)?
options: read-only v1, actions stay in the dossier
clarifications.default: read-only v1, actions stay in the dossier
clarifications.answer: read-only v1, actions stay in the dossier

clarifications.question: The dark review variant: a manual mode toggle, an automatic theme in review phase, or dropped for v1?
Webfonts (Noto Serif + Inter + Public Sans, ~300KB vendored, no CDN): ship them, or system-font fallback v1?
The Decision Studio room: keep the wizard contract exactly (Q-by-Q, Enter submits, approve at end) inside the new card layout?
The Factory pipeline screen: aspiration only for v1, or must it ship?

acceptance.then: every act works both ways, as before

decisions.decision: Alexandria light editorial is THE theme; library-inspector is the primary inspiration (owner directive).
decisions.because: The owner named the direction mid-round; the artifacts confirm coherence.

decisions.decision: The five phases are a presentation layer over the frozen stage vocabulary — no engine stages added or renamed.
decisions.because: D-2 of the spec-library lineage: translation is presentation, the vocabulary is frozen.

decisions.decision: Seam contracts frozen: pages stay engine-name-free, admission only through specweb-events, keyboard and pointer complete, CSP-pinned, no CDN.
decisions.because: The portability thesis is not negotiable for a skin change.

decisions.decision: System font stacks carry the voices: serif headline (Georgia/Iowan/serif), sans body (system-ui), mono status (ui-monospace) — the Alexandria hierarchy without webfont weight.
decisions.because: Owner Q-3: no vendored fonts v1; the hierarchy survives in the stack order.

decisions.decision: The dark review variant ships as a manual, persisted toggle — not auto-in-review, not dropped.
decisions.because: Owner Q-2: the dark posture is valued for review work; the choice stays human.
